topic: Scientific Names and Branches of Biology
description: The study of Scientific Names and Branches of Biology under General Science deals with the classification of organisms and specialized biological fields. It is highly relevant for direct factual questions in competitive exams.

sections.title: Taxonomy and Nomenclature
sections.description: The basic system of identifying, classifying, and providing scientific names to living organisms.

key_concepts.explanation: The scientific study of naming, defining, and classifying groups of biological organisms on the basis of shared characteristics.
A formal system of naming species of living things by giving each a name composed of two parts: the first part indicates the Genus and the second indicates the Species.

historical_events.significance: Carl Linnaeus introduced the comprehensive system of Binomial Nomenclature in this landmark book.

important_facts.fact: Carl Linnaeus is universally recognized as the Father of Taxonomy.
